what: Directory recall prefix match bug: current code (pre-read-recall.sh line 102) treats directory recall as "everything under this dir is recalled" — wrong. Directory recall only returns directory-scoped memories, may miss file-specific ones. Fix: remove prefix match from file-level blocking check. Only exact file|path matches exempt files from blocking. dir|path only exempts the directory TRIGGER (don't re-prompt for broader context), NOT individual file blocks. Each file always blocks until individually recalled.
why: User corrected: I dismissed this as minor but it's a real design flaw. If src/api/ is recalled, ALL files under src/api/ skip blocking — missing file-specific memories. Original intent: each file always blocks for its own recall.
